units.source_text: 到了十月，阴雨昏濛，源氏心情更恶，

en.t: When October came, the rainy gloom made the sky dim and hazy, and Genji's spirits sank even lower,

units.source_text: 怅望暮色，凄凉难堪，独自低吟“十月年年时雨降”之诗。

en.t: he gazed sadly into the dusk, unable to bear the loneliness, and softly chanted to himself the poem, "Every year in October the passing showers fall."

units.source_text: 望见群雁振翅，飞渡长空，不胜羡慕，守视良久。

en.t: Seeing a flock of wild geese beating their wings and crossing the wide sky, he was overcome with envy and watched them for a long time.
